subject: POC kickoff & hands-on sessions — coordinating US/EU/APAC windows
messages:
From: Elena Moretti <elena.moretti@saasco.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC kickoff — hands-on sessions & multi-region coordination

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the quick intro call last week. We’re ready to kick off the POC with Redwood — primary goals are: prompt-review and tuning, routing behavior for our multi-tenant traffic, and an initial set of load tests to validate tail latency under realistic prefixes.

We’d like the kickoff to be hands-on (not just slides) so our engineers can hit the model, walk through routing rules, and run simple load sweeps. Our core attendees will be myself, Rajesh Kumar (platform/infra), and 2 engineers (names to follow).

High-level asks:
- 90-min hands-on session per region (US / EU / APAC)
- A shared agenda and prompt set before the session
- A short load-test window we can run from our infra (we can provide instances)

Target week: March 2–6 ideally, but we’re flexible; we will need at least one EU-friendly time because several of our product folks are in London.

Can you propose a set of rotating start times so your engineers aren’t always on late nights? Also please include any prep items for our team (test tokens, dataset samples).

Thanks — Elena
Elena Moretti
Head of Product
SaaSCo
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moretti <elena.moretti@saasco.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on sessions & multi-region coordination

Hi Elena — great to hear and excited to get this into a hands-on format. I’ve sketched a rotation approach that minimizes repeated late-night shifts for our engineers while hitting your requirement for region-specific sessions. See proposed slots below (all durations are 90 minutes):

Option A (rotate weekly):
- US slot: 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET (covers North America morning)
- EU slot: 16:00 PT / 00:00 CET (evening local EU)
- APAC slot: 22:00 PT / 13:00 SGT next day (late evening US / midday APAC)

Option B (compress into two-day window):
- Day 1: US morning + EU late afternoon
- Day 2: APAC midday (local) + asynchronous follow ups

Practical suggestions:
- We recommend a 30/30/30 split (prompt review / routing walk-through / load test ramp) per session.
- Please confirm which calendar days in March work best and whether APAC needs earlier/slightly later times.

I attached a draft POC agenda for your review (POC_Agenda_v2.pdf). I’ll have Vivek fill in the load-test specifics in a follow-up. Once we agree on dates we’ll send calendar invites with rotating times.

If useful, we can also run the EU session first to get feedback that we can incorporate into the US session later in the week.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[tessa_morgan@redwood.com]
[Attachment: POC_Agenda_v2.pdf (pdf)]
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moretti <elena.moretti@saasco.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 12:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on sessions & multi-region coordination

Hi all — quick technical note to shape the agenda and prep:

Suggested session format (90 minutes):
- 00–30m: prompt review and expected output format (we’ll bring a prompt set and an eval harness)
- 30–60m: routing & policy walkthrough + live verification (canary fallback, model variants)
- 60–90m: load test ramp (we’ll coordinate a short ramp from SaaSCo infra)

Prep items from our side:
- We’ll share a small prompt pack and evaluation script ahead of the session (prompt-set-2026-03.docx).
- For load tests, we need temporary test API keys and one or two host IP ranges whitelisted. I put the detailed steps in load-tests-plan.xlsx.
- Target load-test profile: step from 5 rps to 75 rps over 15 minutes, capture p95/p99 latency and tail error rates.

Hiro — for APAC availability, would you prefer we start the APAC session at 12:00 SGT (23:00 PT) or 13:00 SGT (00:00 PT next day)?

Elena — can you confirm whether SaaSCo will run the ramp from EU or US hosts for the EU session? That affects routing verification.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Principal Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: load-tests-plan.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Elena Moretti <elena.moretti@saasco.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Kumar <r.kumar@platforms.io>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 08:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on sessions & multi-region coordination

Thanks Vivek — Rajesh will lead infra on our side and he confirmed we can provide hosts from both EU and US clouds. A couple of constraints on our side:

- March 2 is a partial holiday for several teams; would you be able to move the EU slot to March 3?
- For APAC, earlier local time is preferred (12:00 SGT is best for the APAC engineers).

If you can put the EU session on March 3 and shift the APAC session start to 12:00 SGT (23:00 PT), that would work well. I’ve copied Rajesh — he’ll coordinate the test VMs and share SSH access/IP ranges.

Also, please send the prompt pack and drive folder link so our product folks can review before the hands-on.

Best,
Elena
Elena Moretti
Head of Product, SaaSCo

Subject: Final schedule & invites: SaaSCo POC kickoff (Mar 3, Mar 4, Mar 5)

Hi Elena / Rajesh — thanks for the quick responses. Per your constraints we’ve finalized a rotating schedule and sent calendar invites for the following slots (Google Calendar links included in invites):

- EU hands-on: 2026-03-03 16:00 PT / 00:00 CET — 90 mins (agenda attached)
- US hands-on: 2026-03-04 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET — 90 mins
- APAC hands-on: 2026-03-05 23:00 PT / 12:00 SGT (next day) — 90 mins

Attachments: POC_Agenda_v2.pdf, load-tests-plan.xlsx, prompt-set-2026-03.docx.

Prep checklist for SaaSCo:
- Provide one or two IP ranges to whitelist for the load ramp by Feb 25
- Confirm which host(s) you’ll run the EU ramp from (Rajesh noted EU and US are both possible)
- Ask your product folks to skim the prompt-set doc and flag any sensitive tokens/PHI we should scrub

We built the invites as rotating so our on-call engineer won’t have to cover every late-night slot. Monica will be running the EU session and I’ll handle the US session; Vivek will lead the load ramp and Hiro will cover APAC timezone support.

Drive folder with materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3POCdocs
Calendar invites: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=saasco-poc-kickoff

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Tessa
